description: AskAbout - Ask each participant about their {topic}

actions.action_goal: {"id": "ask_about_{topic_id}", "description": "Ask each participant about their {topic}.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} learns {participant}'s {topic}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "{robot_name} acknowledges {participant}'s answer.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "criteria_expand": [{"ids": ["c1", "c2"], "mappings": [{"source": "{participants}", "target": "participant"}]}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Complete all criteria for one participant before moving to the next.", "Follow the criteria order.", "Address participants by name.", "Keep the conversation natural, light and fun."]}

topic.description: The topic to ask about (e.g., 'favorite school subject', 'favorite color', 'first pet', 'least favorite food')
